package fixture

import (
	"os/exec"
	"testing"
)

// TestBareCommits commits five ways, none with an identity of its own.
func TestBareCommits(t *testing.T) {
	git := func(args ...string) {}
	git("commit", "-q", "-m", "base")
	_ = exec.Command("git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "work")
	_ = r.git("commit-tree", tree, "-m", "a merge")
	_ = `cd repo && echo two >> f && git commit -q -am two && git push`
	_ = "git -C repo commit -q -m three"

	// Not commit sites: a ref spelling, words in prose, a commit named in a comment
	// (git commit -m four), a word looked for, and an option value.
	_ = "git cat-file -e base^{commit}"
	_ = "Commit refuses before git ever runs"
	_ = "git commit in the step's checkout was refused"
	assert.Contains(t, out, "commit")
	assert.Contains(t, out, "commit", "the tool did not commit: %s", out)
	git("log", "--format=commit %H")
}
